description: This file is a shell script designed for device-initiated firmware download and update management in an embedded system. It contains functions for downloading firmware via TFTP or HTTP, updating firmware status logs, parsing responses from a cloud server, and managing firmware upgrade flow based on responses and device conditions.

methods.name: updateFWDownloadStatus
methods.description: Updates the firmware download status in a designated log file, including protocol, status, failure reasons, version info, and timestamps.

methods.name: getFWVersion
methods.description: Retrieves the current firmware version from version.txt based on version tags.

methods.name: getBuildType
methods.description: Identifies whether the build type is VBN, PROD, QA, or DEV based on firmware version info.

methods.name: sendTLSRequest
methods.description: Performs a curl command to send a TLS request to the cloud URL and checks the HTTP response code.

methods.name: tftpDownload
methods.description: Downloads a file using TFTP protocol from a specified location.

methods.name: httpDownload
methods.description: Downloads a file via HTTP protocol.

methods.name: imageDownloadToLocalServer
methods.description: Handles the process of triggering the image download using specified protocols and files, and updates status accordingly.

methods.name: invokeImageFlasher
methods.description: Executes the image flash process using an external script or tool.

methods.name: getServURL
methods.description: Constructs and returns the server URL for firmware updates based on build type.

methods.name: triggerPCIUpgrade
methods.description: Initiates a PCI upgrade process by downloading and flashing firmware images.

methods.name: checkForValidPCIUpgrade
methods.description: Checks whether a firmware upgrade is needed based on version comparison.

methods.name: checkForUpgrades
methods.description: Evaluates if firmware upgrades are required given current conditions and versions.

methods.name: processJsonResponse
methods.description: Parses the JSON response from the cloud server to extract firmware information and update internal variables.

methods.name: exitForXconf404response
methods.description: Handles exit logic when receiving a 404 response from the server.

methods.name: createJsonString
methods.description: Creates a JSON string with device identification and capabilities info for server communication.

methods.name: sendXCONFTLSRequest
methods.description: Attempts to send a TLS request to the cloud server with retry logic.

methods.name: sendXCONFRequest
methods.description: Wraps the TLS request function for simplified call.
